tiao: Tião: a 65-year-old caipira farmer from the interior of Minas Gerais, old man voice, deep, a bit hoarse and weathered from years in the sun, strong countryside caipira accent with the rolled 'r' of the interior, speaks slowly and simply, calm and protective.
aninha: Aninha: an 8-year-old Brazilian girl, high-pitched childish female voice, small and fragile, hungry and scared after two days hiding alone.
ze: Seu Zé: a 70-year-old Brazilian countryside grandfather, old male voice, weak, hoarse and tired, gentle, breathing heavily because he is badly hurt.
narrador: Brazilian TV news anchor from São Paulo, mature male voice around 50 years old, deep, resonant and authoritative, clear diction with paulistano accent, serious documentary tone with suspense, measured pace with dramatic pauses, like a primetime TV journalism narrator.
